Discovery call 2026-02-24 w/ founding PM (Ari Valdez) + engineering lead (R. Singh). Key points:
- Primary workload: bulk generation for SEO + landing pages; also personalization slots for emails.
- Latency tolerance: can accept 1-2s/token for drafts (not strict), but perceived responsiveness for interactive template editor needs < 250ms for short completions.
- Throughput target: ~600 concurrent generation jobs during peak content pushes; average document length ~800 tokens.
- Cost sensitivity: very high — unit cost per article must be <= $0.10 to match margins. Asking about batching + prefix caching to reduce costs.

- Routing/fallback: want policy to prefer cheaper variants unless quality drop detected; can tolerate small quality deltas for drafts.
- Security: they store partial user prompts and outputs in their DB. Asked about SOC2 and audit logs; legal asked for SOC2 attestation doc (shared). Not asking for VPC or on-prem at this stage.

"We need to be able to spin up a 10k-article batch at 3AM and not get surprised at the bill." — Ari
"If caching can shave 30% off token cost on repeat templates, that's a game changer." — R.
